decisionsTitle: The volunteers' page: the kinder note is an information banner
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16, from a screenshot of the volunteers' page:** «Asta ar trebui să fie într-un banner, să fie mai vizibil: acest disclaimer». The note under the roles (§773: «În funcție de numărul de doritori, există posibilitatea să fie nevoie să acoperi o altă responsabilitate. Mulțumim pentru dorința de a ajuta. Te vom contacta curând.») was a grey `body2` line between the last category card and «Numele tău», easy to miss.

**Decision (amending §773 and §788; the words, the roles, the chips, the «?» and the server are untouched).** The note is the house's public information notice: the MUI `Alert` of `severity="info"`, drawn as the register page and the check-your-email screen draw theirs, with the Alert's own info glyph before the words, full width of the form's column, a clear step above and below (`mt: 2`, `mb: 1`). Theme tokens only, so its palette is the info palette of both looks. The id `<roleIds>-note` (named by the roles' fieldset in `aria-describedby`) and the test id `volunteer-roles-note` sit on the Alert's root. It is static text, not a live message: MUI's default `role="alert"` is cleared on the root (`slotProps.root.role` undefined), so a screen reader reads it with the group and does not announce it on load; the render test asserts there is no `role` on it.

**Refused.** A new component or a coloured div of our own (the house already has the notice); `role="status"` (it would be announced as a live region); a warning severity (it is thanks, not a fault); changing the words.
changelogLine: - **The volunteers' page: the kinder note is a banner** — the note under the roles (thanks, and «you may cover another responsibility») is now the house's information notice with its glyph instead of a grey line, and is not announced as an alert. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 45 and 46 (§773, §788). Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens the volunteers' form, then the note under the roles' list is an information Alert (`MuiAlert-colorInfo`) with its own glyph before the words, right under the last category card and above «Numele tău», carrying the id the roles' fieldset names in `aria-describedby` and the test id `volunteer-roles-note`, with no `role` attribute (static text, not announced on load), the words unchanged in Romanian and English (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
